cli.add_maintenance_tags_help: Geli qaab-dhismeedyada dayactirka ee la soo jeediyay iyadoo laga duulayo ciladaha la helay.
cli.check_backlinks_help: Raadi maqaallada xusa balse aan ku xirin halkan.
cli.check_orphan_help: Hubi in maqaalku leeyahay xiriiriyeyaal wiki oo soo gala.
cli.check_urls_help: Ku samee hubinta HEAD URL-yada la tixraacay si loo helo xiriiriyeyaal dhintay (gaabis ah).
cli.description: Hubiyaha MOS ee marxaladda koowaad ee boggaga Wikipedia.
cli.diff_help: Muuji faraqa u dhexeeya wikitext-ka tooska ah iyo kan maxalliga ah.
cli.dir_help: Baar dhammaan faylasha *-corrected.txt iyo *.wiki ee ku jira gal.
cli.dry_run_help: Hore u eeg isbeddellada adigoon qorin.
cli.fix_help: Si toos ah u hagaaji ciladaha farsamo ee ammaanka ah.
cli.lang_help: Koodhka luqadda UI ee CLI iyo soo-saarka warbixinta (wuxuu beddelaa LC_ALL/LC_MESSAGES/LANG).
cli.maintenance_tag_help: Calaamado dayactir oo dheeraad ah; ku kala soocan hakad ama lagu celin karo.
cli.offline_help: Ka bood hubinta xiriiriyeyaasha guduudan iyo jiritaanka qaybaha.
cli.output_wikitext_file_help: Ku qor wikitext-ka la cusboonaysiiyay faylkan.
cli.quiet_help: Qari soo-saarka aan khaladka ahayn; koodhka ka-bixidda oo keliya.
cli.wikitext_file_help: Ka akhri wikitext fayl maxalli ah halkii aad ka akhrin lahayd API.
error.derive_title: Cinwaan lagama soo saari karin URL-ka: {target}

error.target_required: Khalad: bartilmaameed ayaa loo baahan yahay (ama isticmaal --dir habka kooxeed).

note.skipping_api_checks: fiiro: lama samayn karin macmiilka API; waa laga boodayaa hubinnada ku salaysan API
report.no_issues: Wax cilado MOS oo marxaladda koowaad ah lama helin.
status.maintenance_tags_would_add: Calaamadaha dayactirka ee lagu dari lahaa: {tags}
status.no_diff: Ma jiro farqi u dhexeeya wikitext-ka tooska ah iyo kan maxalliga ah.

warn.skipping_not_utf8: Digniin: waa laga boodayaa {name} (ma aha UTF-8): {error}
